verdict.rationale: The docs show a 'Get Account Payment (ACH) details' capability alongside account validation and ownership verification. A developer can retrieve verified account and routing data and pass it to their own payment processor. However, the pack shows no named processor integrations and no processor-token exchange that hands credentials to third parties directly; the access-token docs cover only API authentication. Missing for 10: documented third-party processor/platform integrations, processor token exchange mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.
